notes: The universe remains degenerate in the ways integration round 2 recorded, and w107 closes none of them. Two measured findings worth reading beside this gate. First, the v1 rectangle cannot make food: of the 59 authored resource-yield effects at target universe, exactly five sit in a v1 cell and all five route to stone, because terram is the only material-bearing form among the twelve. Every ruleset comparison taken inside the v1 rectangle is therefore an argument about stone. Second, stated carefully because the sloppy version has misled several readers: advanceConstruction and applyLibraryUpkeep both have production callers in world-step.ts and run every tick, so construction is NOT inert. What is measured over 1200 ticks of the reference universe with zero god actions is constructionStoneOwed 0, buildProgressAdded 0, universitiesCompleted 0, against exactly one university -- the seeded academy, already complete. Founding a site is a god action, so with no actions submitted there is nothing to advance and stone is never spent. Those two facts together are why the campaign-plan W90 measurement of a yield-maximising ruleset was null by construction of its arms rather than for want of a mechanism: the arms could only make stone, and stone had nothing to buy.
rationale: Provenance only, and the numbers did not move. contentRevision goes d4e3047657b4fa8a1a74e1d52f9f5c86 -> b63bd615c1877925b36c7b3eb7812731 on merging origin/main into w109/alliances: the union of apply-magic two autonomy-weight scalars and this branch seventeenth god cost, action 16 inviteScholar. gate.ts refuses a cross-build comparison before it reads a metric, so this file had to be re-recorded whether or not anything moved. NOTHING MOVED: regenerate-baseline.mjs printed "no metric moved", supersededDeltas is a column of zeros, and every metric row here is byte-identical to the file it supersedes. Why nothing moved, measured three ways. First, auditPool on this tree, with action 16 forced into every audited set and each run checked against an untouched one by snapshotHash so the instrument is known not to have disturbed the run, reports action 16 legal on 0 of 60 and 0 of 240 ticks for all fourteen pool strategies, including uniform-random-legal, the only gate strategy that samples the legal set and therefore the only one a widened mask could move. It first becomes legal at world tick 276 under passive play, which is past both gate horizons and is the number to check before lengthening one. Second, forcing invitableSpecies empty, so action 16 can never have a candidate, reproduces the agency gate byte for byte across all 90 comparisons. Third, running these gates on clean origin/main at 7694528 in a separate worktree reproduces every comparison in them. NO RNG STREAM was added, NO WORLD SCHEMA REVISION was needed, and NO GOLDEN FIXTURE WAS REGENERATED. This file is a measurement, not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids a balance claim before 0.5.0, and nothing here claims the universe is balanced. It remains degenerate in the ways the note below records.
